Bullous pemphigoid, together with haemolytic anaemia and diarrhoea,1 and fixed drug eruptions2-4 have been associated with the use of mefenamic acid. Addition- ally, Stevens-Johnson syndrome, together with cholestatic hepa- titis and haemolytic anaemia, in one patient has been attributed to mefenamic acid.5 It is generally recommended that mefenam- ic acid should be withdrawn if skin reactions develop. 1.
